title: German Eggplant Tagine
description: A twist on traditional Moroccan tagine, this German-inspired dish features eggplant as the main ingredient.
instructions: Cut eggplant in half lengthwise and scoop out the insides.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sauté chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add Moroccan spice blend and German seasoning blend; cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add heavy cream (if using) and stir to combine.
Place eggplant halves in a baking dish and spoon the tagine mixture into the eggplant.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until eggplant is tender.
Serve with crusty bread on the side.
